name: @odu/cloudflare-lane
//: The FAR side of a Cloudflare Containers lane — see README.md. Nothing in odu imports this package's code: `odu cloudflare setup` hands its directory to wrangler, which bundles `src/worker.ts` (and embeds `src/bridge.ts` + `src/entrypoint.sh` as text) and deploys it to the operator's own account. `@cloudflare/containers` is a dependency only so the bundle wrangler builds resolves it from this tree, offline, at the version pinned in bun.lock.
